Dynamic rate changes are sampled per runqueue update, not synchronized across CPUs; do not claim uniform wall-time decay for every signal/path.

records.rationale: All three paths read. Retain ordinary GPL multiplier notification/veto hook under the sysctl handler mutex. Old/current values are passed by value and ret starts at successful proc_dointvec result 0. Nonzero veto restores sysctl value without publishing a new shift. Hook runs before the 1/2/4 validity switch, so callback can see rejected values and must not assume success or recursively write this sysctl. Rollback does not undo callback side effects or proc handler file-position changes. Exact SDK registration unconfirmed; retain source API.

Replacements must maintain clocks, average fields and return semantics under caller locking; unsafe callbacks can break scheduling. Set-next hook runs even when native aggregate update is skipped because previous donor was RT; first=false returns before the hook. security: Multiplier changes scheduler load estimation rather than task execution-time accounting. sysctl 0644 and 1/2/4 whitelist constrain normal userspace control; callback veto and default multiplier 1 retained. Modified timing can affect scheduling/frequency choices and responsiveness; no performance/power claim. Active override callbacks are trusted kernel code and may bypass native accounting deliberately; native default bodies and latest fixes remain. Clock deltas use existing signed arithmetic, not newly proven arbitrary-jump overflow bounds.
timing_limits: Shift is READ_ONCE per rq update, so writes are not an atomic cross-CPU clock transition. Already accumulated clocks are not rescaled. Native idle-migration lag estimation still extrapolates from unscaled sched_clock_cpu; hardware pressure uses its native clock too. Therefore the 32/16/8ms shorthand describes multiplier intent, not proof of uniform wall-time half-life across every signal/path or rate transition. Default 1 adds the same deltas to zero-initialized clock_task_mult and clock_task absent trusted overrides.
uncertainty: Scoped searches found no sched_pelt_multiplier/sched_pelt_lshift writer in GrapheneOS system/core, frameworks/base, device/generic/goldfish or manifest common-modules. This is not proof of no need. Retain Android runtime/configuration/source APIs conservatively; exact SDK nondefault policy and callbacks remain unconfirmed. No runtime convergence, migration, clock-transition, latency, frequency or power measurement.
validation: Source/function identity and explicit delta checks; source already compiled in emulator build 126. No additional source changes in this review. Native 79a074be9b57 synchronization remains in set_next_task_idle after previous-class accounting.
